design: At MLP11 normalized input, cross recipient versus matched unfronted native context z with recipient versus unfronted input response e caused by fixed signed Attention5 perturbation. Replace only MLP11 response around recipient native output; all other downstream computation live. Four crossings per recipient/frame, both doses/signs. Prepositional cells are duplicate/self controls.
identity: B(z+e)-B(z)=Down(Left(z)*Right(e)+Left(e)*Right(z)+Left(e)*Right(e)). Audit direct native output differences and separate linear/quadratic terms.
scope: Counterfactual post-normalization context/response crossings need not be natural states. Distinguishes conditional bilinear response from incoming normalized-input response, not whole-layer normalization or unique semantic features.
